name: ubsagora
description: UBS Agora - APIs Node simples (NestJS + Prisma + PostgreSQL)

scripts.install:all: for a in farmacia agendamento fila; do npm --prefix apps/$a install; done
scripts.setup: for a in farmacia agendamento fila; do (cd apps/$a && npx prisma migrate deploy && npx prisma generate && npm run seed) || exit 1; done
scripts.build: for a in farmacia agendamento fila; do npm --prefix apps/$a run build || exit 1; done
